known_secrets.text: The Citadel platform shows at least three distinct construction phases.
The thickest, outermost layer of brick dates to the period after the Turning.
The Lower Town's covered drains were expanded urgently in that same period.
Elira showed him a record referencing a Citadel wing that no longer exists anywhere on the mound.
His structural dating independently matches Sena's oral-history timeline.

unknowns: Meaning of the Signs on the seals
What happened to the vanished Citadel wing Elira's record mentions
Why the Citadel was reinforced so heavily right after the Turning
